Network Service Group Z Resource Add Custom Network Service Group
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/networkServiceGroups

Updates the list of network service groups.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

ID of the network service group.

name
string

Name of the network service group.

services
object[]
description
string

Description of the network service group.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the network service group is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
